description: Development environment for Android Jetpack extension libraries under the androidx namespace. Synchronized with Android Jetpack's primary development branch on AOSP.
vibe: Scope everything, read the nearest guide, and never configure the whole build.
highlights: Explicitly scopes work to a module and warns that configuring the whole repo is slow.
Introduces PROJECT_PREFIX env var to cap which Gradle projects get configured.
Points to per-directory AGENTS.md files and skills rather than duplicating guidance.
Distinguishes the AOSP Gerrit/Googler path from the GitHub PR flow and declares the latter out of scope.
Warns against assuming Gradle project paths mirror directories; instructs grepping settings.gradle instead.
assessment: This guide reflects mature monorepo discipline: it treats build configuration cost as a first-class concern and gives concrete levers (PROJECT_PREFIX, ./studiow, targeted tasks) instead of vague advice. By delegating deep workflows to skills and per-module AGENTS.md files, it keeps the top-level file lean while still enforcing required stanzas like Test: and Change-Id:. The explicit 'don't assume, grep settings.gradle' rule is a small but high-leverage anti-slop constraint that prevents a common class of agent errors.
